prerequisites.recommended: Prior experience with Adobe Creative Cloud.

what_you_will_be_able_to_do: Animate complex vector illustrations in After Effects

why_now.industry_shift: Brands are abandoning static graphics for dynamic, video-first content across all social and digital platforms.
why_now.ai_impact: While AI automates rotoscoping and tracking, spatial design and timing still require expert human craft.
why_now.business_demand: High demand for versatile motion designers in tech, advertising, and streaming networks.
why_now.career_opportunity: Premium rates for specialists who bridge the gap between graphic design and 3D animation.

learning_outcomes: MASTER: Advanced keyframing, graph editor curves, and expression-based animation.
ANIMATE: Fully rigged 2D characters and complex kinetic typography sequences.
INTEGRATE: 3D models and lighting setups via the Cineware workflow.
DELIVER: A polished, beat-synced professional showreel.

core_tools.what_student_builds: Explainer videos, UI animations, and kinetic typography sequences.

ai_integration.ai_cannot_replace: Creative timing, storytelling pacing, and brand-specific aesthetic decisions.

best_practices: Always organize project panels with folders (Assets, Comps, Pre-Comps, Renders).
Label and color-code layers for complex compositions.
Use null objects and expressions to control multiple layers simultaneously.

common_mistakes.why_it_happens: Ignoring the graph editor out of fear of complexity.
common_mistakes.professional_approach: Always use easing (F9) and adjust speed graphs for natural, physical motion.

common_mistakes.why_it_happens: Failing to release layers to sequence in Illustrator.
common_mistakes.professional_approach: Prep vectors meticulously before importing as a composition.

faq.question: Do I need to be good at drawing to be a motion designer?
faq.answer: No, while illustration helps, much of motion graphics relies on manipulating existing vectors, typography, and shape layers.

faq.question: Is my computer fast enough for After Effects?
faq.answer: After Effects is extremely RAM-heavy. We strongly recommend at least 32GB of RAM and a dedicated GPU to avoid frustrating lag.

faq.question: Will I learn the full version of Cinema 4D?
faq.answer: We focus on Cinema 4D Lite which is included for free with After Effects, teaching you enough to integrate 3D seamlessly into 2D workflows.

faq.question: Are software licenses included in the course?
faq.answer: No, you will need to purchase your own Adobe Creative Cloud subscription.

modules.module_purpose: Master the After Effects interface and the core principles of animation timing.
what_you_will_learn: The 12 principles of animation applied to UI

lessons.what_is_taught: Interface layout, compositions, frame rates, and importing layered assets.
lessons.why_it_matters: Proper setup prevents frame rate mismatches and chaotic, unmanageable projects later.
lessons.what_learner_does: Creates a structured project folder and sets up a standard 1080p composition.
lessons.expected_outcome: An organized project ready for animation.

lessons.what_is_taught: Linear vs Bezier keyframes, and using the Graph Editor for speed control.
lessons.why_it_matters: Easing is what separates amateur, robotic animation from professional, organic motion.
lessons.what_learner_does: Animates a bouncing ball and UI elements using speed graph adjustments.
lessons.expected_outcome: Smooth, realistic object motion with weight and anticipation.

lessons.what_is_taught: Creating alpha mattes, luma mattes, and animating mask paths.
lessons.why_it_matters: Essential for seamless transitions, text reveals, and complex compositing.
lessons.what_learner_does: Builds a clean text reveal utilizing track mattes.
lessons.expected_outcome: A professional lower-third graphic ready for broadcast.

lessons.what_is_taught: Grouping layers with pre-comps and parenting to master null objects.
lessons.why_it_matters: Keeps timelines clean and allows for complex hierarchical animations without breaking keyframes.
lessons.what_learner_does: Rigs a mechanical arm using parenting chains.
lessons.expected_outcome: A complex animation driven by a single master control.

modules.assignment: Deliverable: 5-second logo animation with easing and mattes.
modules.business_application: Logo intros for corporate videos and YouTube channels.
modules.expected_outcome: Solid grasp of 2D animation fundamentals in AE.

modules.module_purpose: Create dynamic vector animations and automate motion with expressions and text animators.

lessons.what_is_taught: Trim paths, repeater, wiggle paths, and merge paths within shape layers.
lessons.why_it_matters: Allows for complex, procedural vector animations without keyframing every single element.
lessons.what_learner_does: Creates bursting fireworks and radial UI elements.
lessons.expected_outcome: A complex abstract vector background.

lessons.what_is_taught: Range selectors, animating by word/line/character, and per-character 3D.
lessons.why_it_matters: Text animators are incredibly powerful for automated typographic motion without manual keyframing.
lessons.what_learner_does: Builds 3 unique, reusable text animation presets.
lessons.expected_outcome: Dynamic text reveals saved as animation presets.

lessons.what_is_taught: Syncing text to audio beats, dynamic camera moves, and layout transitions.
lessons.why_it_matters: Highly demanded for commercials, social media ads, and lyric videos.
lessons.what_learner_does: Animates a 15-second voiceover quote.
lessons.expected_outcome: A punchy, well-timed kinetic typography sequence.

lessons.what_is_taught: Writing basic JavaScript for AE: time, wiggle, loopOut, and linking properties via pickwhip.
lessons.why_it_matters: Saves hours of keyframing and allows for procedural, scalable animation.
lessons.what_learner_does: Rigs a looping background element and a wiggling camera.
lessons.expected_outcome: An automated, code-driven animation sequence.

modules.hands_on_practice: Build a kinetic typography scene synced to an audio clip.
modules.business_application: Social media video ads and lyric videos.
modules.expected_outcome: Ability to create engaging text and vector motion efficiently.

modules.module_purpose: Bridge the gap between 2D compositing and true 3D using After Effects and C4D Lite.

lessons.what_is_taught: Converting layers to 3D, Z-depth setup, multi-node cameras, and depth of field.
lessons.why_it_matters: Adds cinematic depth and production value to flat vector designs.
lessons.what_learner_does: Creates a fly-through animation across multiple 3D text layers.
lessons.expected_outcome: A spatial composition with depth and a smooth camera move.

lessons.what_is_taught: Interface basics, creating C4D files directly in AE, and the live Cineware bridge.
lessons.why_it_matters: Enables seamless integration of true 3D assets without tedious render exports.
lessons.what_learner_does: Creates a basic 3D scene and links it live to an After Effects composition.
lessons.expected_outcome: A live 3D asset running and updating within AE.

lessons.what_is_taught: Primitives, splines, extrude NURBS, and basic PBR materials.
lessons.why_it_matters: Allows creation of 3D logos, text, and simple objects for client branding.
lessons.what_learner_does: Extrudes a 2D vector logo into 3D and applies glossy/metallic materials.
lessons.expected_outcome: A photorealistic 3D logo asset.

lessons.what_is_taught: Using Cloners and Random effectors in C4D, then extracting 3D scene data into AE for multi-pass compositing.
lessons.why_it_matters: MoGraph is the core of C4D's power for procedural motion graphics.
lessons.what_learner_does: Animates a grid of objects forming a logo, then composites it with 2D overlays in AE.
lessons.expected_outcome: A highly polished 2D/3D hybrid logo reveal.

modules.hands_on_practice: Create a 3D product shot or logo reveal.
modules.assignment: Deliverable: 3D logo animation composited with 2D elements.
modules.business_application: Premium tech product videos and sports broadcast packages.
modules.expected_outcome: Proficiency in the AE to C4D workflow.

modules.module_purpose: Prepare and animate 2D characters for explainer videos and digital campaigns.

lessons.what_is_taught: Structuring Illustrator files, anchor point placement, and grouping for limbs.
lessons.why_it_matters: Improper file prep makes rigging impossible and breaks character joints.
lessons.what_learner_does: Organizes a character file in Illustrator and imports it correctly into AE.
lessons.expected_outcome: A ready-to-rig character composition.

lessons.what_is_taught: Setting up limbs using basic expressions or free scripts like Duik Bassel.
lessons.why_it_matters: IK makes animating arms and legs drastically faster and more natural than FK.
lessons.what_learner_does: Rigs a bipedal character's arms and legs.
lessons.expected_outcome: A fully functional, controllable character rig.

lessons.what_is_taught: Contact, down, pass, and up poses; creating seamless looping walk cycles.
lessons.why_it_matters: The fundamental test of character animation skills.
lessons.what_learner_does: Animates a seamless looping walk cycle.
lessons.expected_outcome: A character walking convincingly in place.

lessons.what_is_taught: Joystick controllers for head turns and time-remapping for phoneme mouth shapes.
lessons.why_it_matters: Adds personality, emotion, and narrative capability to characters.
lessons.what_learner_does: Rigs a face and lip-syncs a short audio clip.
lessons.expected_outcome: A speaking, expressive character animation.

modules.hands_on_practice: Rig and animate a character performing a specific action (e.g., waving, walking).
modules.assignment: Deliverable: Character walk cycle + wave animation.
modules.business_application: Start-up explainer videos and educational content.
modules.expected_outcome: Ability to rig and animate a 2D character from scratch.

modules.module_purpose: Compile, polish, and present a professional motion design showreel to secure employment or freelance clients.

lessons.what_is_taught: Creating a cohesive set of graphics (bumpers, lower thirds, transitions) based on a network brief.
lessons.why_it_matters: Proves the ability to maintain brand consistency across multiple dynamic assets.
lessons.what_learner_does: Designs and animates a 3-part broadcast graphics package.
lessons.expected_outcome: A cohesive capstone project demonstrating advanced design skills.

lessons.lesson_title: Editing the Showreel in Premiere Pro
lessons.what_is_taught: Culling weak projects, cutting to the beat, intro/outro design, and pacing.
lessons.why_it_matters: A reel is only as strong as its weakest shot; editing dictates the perceived energy of your work.
lessons.what_learner_does: Edits their best course projects into a tight 60-second sequence.
lessons.expected_outcome: A dynamic, beat-synced showreel draft.

lessons.what_is_taught: Adding swooshes, impacts, risers, and EQing music in Premiere/Audition.
lessons.why_it_matters: Sound design accounts for 50% of the perceived quality and impact of motion graphics.
lessons.what_learner_does: Adds a comprehensive sound design pass to their showreel.
lessons.expected_outcome: A punchy, professional-sounding reel.

lessons.what_is_taught: Building Behance case studies, exporting optimal formats, and setting freelance rates.
lessons.why_it_matters: Technical skills must be paired with business acumen to succeed in the industry.
lessons.what_learner_does: Publishes their reel and finalizes their online portfolio.
lessons.expected_outcome: A public-facing, professional motion designer presence ready for clients.

modules.hands_on_practice: Edit, mix, and finalize the 60-second capstone showreel.
modules.business_application: Applying for agency roles or pitching freelance clients.
modules.expected_outcome: A fully finished, industry-ready portfolio and showreel.
